findings.title: ADR is draft/proposed while REQ-012 R15 wording asks for an accepted ADR
findings.evidence: ADR-030 frontmatter status: draft and Status section 'awaiting the owner's ratification'; REQ-012 line 76 'An accepted ADR covers...'
findings.consequence: The phase acceptance (a decision on each of six questions) is met, but the requirement is satisfied in full only after owner acceptance; phase-wbf-08 builds on an unratified record
findings.minimal_fix: No change to the ADR; hold phase-wbf-08 until the owner ratifies

findings.title: Env-var token rejection rationale does not distinguish the file token
findings.evidence: ADR section 3 and alternatives: env token rejected because shells inherit it, yet a shell running as the owner can read data/terminal-api-token; the ADR itself concedes an owner-run process can read the file
findings.consequence: The stated reason for the file over the env var overclaims; the real difference is passive inheritance only
findings.minimal_fix: Reword the alternative to say the file avoids inheritance but not deliberate reads by a shell running as the owner

findings.title: R19 paragraph contradicts itself about whether the buffer exists
findings.evidence: 'no buffer is created' followed by 'The buffer and last-activity record on the websocket side... exist but no route reads them'
findings.consequence: Ambiguous meaning of the R19 test 'buffer mapping unchanged'; the buffer costs memory under the first flag alone
findings.minimal_fix: State that the websocket-side buffer exists whenever the first flag is set, and that R19 checks only that a request to an absent route changes nothing

findings.title: Route contract leaves edge cases to the builder
findings.evidence: 415 vs 401 ordering unspecified; peer check accepts only 127.0.0.1 and ::1 (not ::ffff:127.0.0.1); read updates last-activity so a poller holds a session slot indefinitely
findings.consequence: phase-wbf-08 must decide these without guidance
findings.minimal_fix: Add one line each: check order peer, token, content type; address normalisation; note the slot-holding consequence

findings.title: Catalog entry for ADR-030 not visible in the supplied diff
findings.evidence: Brief says the diff includes the catalog; the diff contains only the ADR; readable checkout's catalog.md lists only ADR-029 and is not at the reviewed commit
findings.consequence: Cannot confirm the catalog entry; governance exit 0 at the reviewed commit is indirect support
findings.minimal_fix: Confirm catalog regeneration is in the commit range

notes: Shadow judge (gating: false), same brief as the gating reviewer plus the runner manifest; no checkout. Its F02, F03 and F04 coincide with the gating reviewer's F03, F05, F02/F07, which the builder fixed before this record was written; F05 is a brief artefact (the coordinator's brief excludes catalog.md from the diff by design; the catalog is in the range). Evidence file is the judge's final message transcribed by the coordinator (the judge has no write tool); findings and JSON verbatim, narrative condensed.
